description: A noise source switchable between white and pink, with a sample and hold beside it

params.text: Chooses the noise colour, W for white and P for pink

inputs.text: The signal the sample and hold takes its samples from; with nothing patched here it samples the module's own noise
Takes a sample on each rising edge, reading high above 1V and low below 0V

outputs.text: The voltage caught at the last trigger, held until the next one, and 0V before the first

notes: the sample and hold output holds at 0V until a trigger is patched to TRIG
the pink setting is a three-section filter trimmed to about the same level as the white setting, so the switch does not jump the output level

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the module's own noise.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
